# NOAA Fisheries

> > Official resource for the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration's fisheries management, marine species protection, and sustainable fishing regulations across U.S. waters.

NOAA Fisheries manages fisheries under the Magnuson-Stevens Act, protects marine mammals and endangered species under the ESA and Marine Mammal Protection Act, and conducts scientific research through regional science centers. The agency oversees fishery management plans, incidental take authorizations, critical habitat designations, and recovery plans for threatened and endangered marine species from Alaska to the Pacific Islands and along the West Coast.

## Key Topics

- Endangered Species Act (ESA)
- Marine Mammal Protection Act
- Incidental Take Authorizations
- Fishery Management Plans (FMP)
- Gulf of Alaska Groundfish Management
- Prohibited Species Catch (PSC)
- Critical Habitat Designations
- Alaska Regional Office
- West Coast Fisheries
- Pacific Islands Region
- Chinook Salmon Bycatch
- Recovery Plans
- Letters of Authorization
- Magnuson-Stevens Fishery Conservation and Management Act
- Marine Conservation

## Endangered Species & Protected Resources

- [Listing of Humpback Whale Under the Endangered Species Act](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/action/listing-humpback-whale-under-endangered-species-act): ESA listing revision for humpback whale distinct population segments
- [Recovery Plan for White Abalone](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/action/recovery-plan-white-abalone): Recovery plan for endangered white abalone (Haliotis sorenseni) species
- [Black Abalone Listing Under the ESA](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/action/black-abalone-listing-under-esa): ESA endangered listing for black abalone (Haliotis cracherodii) species
- [Endangered Species Act 4(d) Rule for Elkhorn and Staghorn Corals](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/action/endangered-species-act-4d-rule-elkhorn-and-staghorn-corals): ESA 4(d) rule applying Section 9 prohibitions to elkhorn and staghorn corals
- [Listing Guadalupe Fur Seal Under the ESA](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/action/listing-guadalupe-fur-seal-under-esa): ESA threatened species listing for Guadalupe fur seal (Actocephalus townsendi)
- [Critical Habitat Designation For Leatherback Sea Turtles Along the U.S. West Coast](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/action/critical-habitat-designation-leatherback-sea-turtles-along-us-west-coast): Critical habitat designation for leatherback sea turtles along West Coast

## Incidental Take Authorizations

- [Incidental Take Authorization: U.S. Navy Hawaii-Southern California Training and Testing (HSTT) (2018-2025)](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/action/incidental-take-authorization-us-navy-hawaii-southern-california-training-and-testing-hstt): Marine mammal take authorization for U.S. Navy HSTT activities 2018-2025
- [Incidental Take Permit to North Carolina Division of Marine Fisheries for Sea Turtles](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/action/incidental-take-permit-north-carolina-division-marine-fisheries-sea-turtles): Sea turtle incidental take permit for North Carolina commercial gillnet fishery
- [Incidental Take Authorization: Apache Alaska Corp. Seismic Survey in Cook Inlet, AK](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/action/incidental-take-authorization-apache-alaska-corp-seismic-survey-cook-inlet-ak): Marine mammal take authorization for Apache Alaska seismic surveys in Cook Inlet
- [Incidental Take Authorization: NOAA Fisheries PIFSC Fisheries and Ecosystem Research Activities in the Pacific Ocean](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/action/incidental-take-authorization-noaa-fisheries-pifsc-fisheries-and-ecosystem-research): Marine mammal take authorization for PIFSC Pacific fisheries research activities
- [Incidental Take Authorization: Sonoma County Water Agency's Estuary Management Activities in Sonoma County, California](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/action/incidental-take-authorization-sonoma-county-water-agencys-estuary-management-activities): Marine mammal take authorization for Russian River estuary management activities
- [Incidental Take Authorization: Alaska DOT Sand Point City Dock Replacement Project, Sand Point, AK](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/action/incidental-take-authorization-alaska-dot-sand-point-city-dock-replacement-project-sand-point): Marine mammal IHA for Alaska DOT Sand Point dock replacement construction

## Gulf of Alaska Groundfish Management

- [Amendment 103 to the FMP for the Groundfish of the Gulf of Alaska Management Area](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/action/amendment-103-fmp-groundfish-gulf-alaska-management-area): Gulf of Alaska groundfish FMP amendment for Chinook salmon PSC reapportionment
- [Amendment 95 to the FMP for the Groundfish of the Gulf of Alaska Management Area](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/action/amendment-95-fmp-groundfish-gulf-alaska-management-area): Gulf of Alaska groundfish FMP amendment modifying halibut PSC limits
- [Amendment 96 to the FMP for the Groundfish of the Gulf of Alaska Management Area](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/action/amendment-96-fmp-groundfish-gulf-alaska-management-area): Gulf of Alaska FMP amendment for CQE quota share acquisition and IFQ program

## Science Centers & Research Programs

- [Climate and Ecosystems Program, Southwest Fisheries Science Center](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/about/climate-and-ecosystems-program-southwest-fisheries-science-center): Southwest Fisheries Science Center program for climate and ecosystem research
- [National Program Office for Equal Employment Opportunity](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/about/eeo): NOAA Fisheries EEO office promoting workplace equity and civil rights compliance

## Optional

- [Fisheries of the Northeastern United States: Atlantic Sea Scallop Fishery; 2018 Closure of Northern Gulf of Maine Scallop Management Area](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/action/fisheries-northeastern-united-states-atlantic-sea-scallop-fishery-2018-closure-northern-gulf): 2018 closure of Northern Gulf of Maine scallop area for Limited Access vessels
- [Notice of Availability of a Final Supplemental Environmental Impact Statement for Management of the Subsistence Harvest of Northern Fur Seals on St. Paul Island, Alaska](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/action/notice-availability-final-supplemental-environmental-impact-statement-management-subsistence): Final EIS for northern fur seal subsistence harvest management on St. Paul Island
